Segment commentary (no numeric split): Transportation — Road and Rail revenue down (RDP completions, HS2 rescheduling); Integrated Transport strong (Heathrow). Natural Resources — Energy and Defence/Nuclear up; Water stable (AMP7 close, AMP8 early design). Consultancy 17% of group revenue (FY24: 12%) — source path as above.

Pension: triennial review agreement (announced 26 Jan 2026) removes defined-benefit scheme dividend-parity constraint; returns to shareholders no longer trigger matching pension contributions; deficit/surplus balance and contribution amounts not in this extract — source path as above.

Capital returns: FY25 full-year dividend proposed 4.2p (final 3.2p + interim; FY24: 2.4p), target cover 3× adjusted EPS; AGM payment 26 May 2026; £10m on-market buyback completed in FY24 and FY25; £20m buyback planned FY26 (announcement 10 Mar 2026); no scrip dividend mentioned; share count reduced by buybacks but not quantified — source path as above.
Qualitative risk language only: rigorous contract selection, commercial assurance, supply-chain management; ambition for margins >5.0%; no going-concern or viability-statement text in extract.
